notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 - version 5.1.3 update
notes.notes:
Update: The play balance in the 'Keep the Supplies Going' mission.
Update: Some German transport vehicles to Sd.Kfz 7's.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 - update version 5.1.2
notes.notes:
Change: The hex highlights in the first tutorial mission.
Fix: An issue on some displays of the 'End Turn' button highlight size.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 version 5.1.1 update
notes.notes: Fix: An issue on some displays of the 'End Turn' button highlight size.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 version 5.1.0 update
notes.notes:
Change: Some improvements to the main map display.
Change: The tree density on some maps.
Fix: Some terrain was not providing cover against shooting, as per the terrain effects chart.
Fix: Some woodland hexes were incorrectly allowing units to pass through them in a single movement action.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 - version 5.0.7 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Change: The bonus 'Assault' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 - version 5.0.5 update.
notes.notes: Fix: Some incorrect campaign names in the completed campaigns window.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 - version 5.0.4 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix: Issue of an aircraft image sometimes appearing after selecting off board artillery.
[*] Fix: Some button alignment issues.
[*] Fix: Some spelling errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 version 5.0.3 update
notes.notes: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Tank Battle: 1944 v5.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Add: Weapon animations.
[*] Change: Reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Improved: computer player A.I.
[*] Change: Game balance of the 'Supply and Demand' scenario.
[*] Fix: Some side assignment issues n the Bastogne Campaign.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount/dismount buttons.
[*] Fix: 'Behind enemy lines' mission.  Removed the turn limit.
[/list]

notes.title: Update.
notes.notes:
Fix: A major update to the game AI.  Ranged units that were far from enemy units are now more responsive.
Fix: Prevent deselection of units that can morph before their end of turn.

notes.title: Update.
notes.notes:
"Change: Some Artillery unit values.
Change; Play Balance in the Congestion Mission.
Fix: Minor Bug Fixes.
Fix: Some button layout issues.
Add: Game Speed Option in settings menu, with 3 settings Standard, Slow and Fast.
Fix: Improved hex tile Positioning accuracy.
Fix: Improved memory management.

notes.title: Update.
notes.notes:
Fix: Wrong image for 'how to move' in the how to play section.
Fix: Some Spelling and Grammatical errors.

Any issues please contact support@hexwar.com

[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy the game.

~The HexWar Games Team

Thanks for supporting our games and please keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Patch 1 released!
notes.notes:
We've just released the first patch for the game which includes the following:
[list][*]Added configurable keyboard shortcuts (scrolling the map, ending turn, select next unit etc.)
[*]Added option to unlock all scenarios in the settings menu so they no longer need to be played in order.
[*]Added option to restart the current mission.
[*]Fixed issue with units being able to shoot more than once.
[*]Fixed issue with full screen on Mac.
[/list]
Thanks for supporting our games and please keep the feedback coming!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: First patch incoming!
notes.notes:
We've been listening to your feedback on the forum and are aiming to release our first patch later this week!

As well as bug fixes, we are aiming to add the following improvements:

[list]
[*]Option to restart the current mission from the in-game menu.
[*]Configurable hotkeys (for example to end the turn)
[*]Option to unlock all the scenarios so they don't need to be played in a specific order.

Thanks for supporting our games! :)

~ The HexWar Games Team
